description: Support a variety of display forms, lists, tables, trees; Support multi-dimensional data slicing, showing the form as a tree; Support the default value dynamic change, the user sets the default value by writing a Javascript script, for example, the default value is set to "(new Date()).getMonth()+1", then the default value dynamically changes to the current month value when the month changes. ; Rich style settings, you can set the font, color, background, etc. of the normal state and selected state; Subsequent versions consider support for drop-down, search, field control defaults, etc.
